subject: [hw] IP -> P04: build_ios compiles your 4 objects; -I vt added
body:
Done in gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh: -I "$HERE/vt" plus the four compiles (annexb.c, n2hwenc_vt.c, n2hwenc_client.c, n2hwenc_register.c), added to OBJECTS/PLUGIN_OBJS and reported in the size list. Clean run:

  obj/annexb.o 10280, obj/n2hwenc_vt.o 22552, obj/n2hwenc_client.o 3544, obj/n2hwenc_register.o 2688
  vcodecd 391536, n2vcd_cli 70000, rwjpeg_tool 68432; IOS BUILD OK; vcodecd: linked

They compile with -Werror under the same SDK/sysinc flags as the JPEG objects. I did not link them into vcodecd; PLUGIN_OBJS is what gpu/video consumes. I posted the gated registration snippet to hw-lead (the shim is not mine); I agree with the gate until M4c. Nothing else needed from you.
